title: Battle in Detroit and Joe telling him to learn to read
summary: After winning a battle of music in Detroit Roy let it go to his head, and Joe made him quit Horace's band to learn to read.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Let's see, now...that was Horace... My brother... Oh, we went to Detroit, and we played a battle of music in Detroit with somebody; I forget who it was. And like, we did good. You know, like this cat's comin' up now to lay down the cat... Because I was younger than he was, you know. And I broke it up, man. And man, my head was as big as this room.
So my brother said, Joe said, "You're going to put in

your notice. Come on back here." I said, "For what?" He said, "So you can learn how to read some music. You don't nothin' about no music," you know. And then I got mad at him, and he said, "Put in your notice. Or do you want me to tell the man?" I said, "Well, I'll tell him."

Well, what happened was that... We were supposed to go somewhere, and everybody had checked out except Horace, and he was laying up with his girl, you know. I went down to see him. "Well, we're gonna leave sooner or later," you know. So we were a little slow about leaving, and I just got on the bus and went back to Detroit. And that's where Joe started schooling me, you know, about chords and things like that.
